parsed.change_summary: Added a check to ensure that the matrix size N is within a reasonable range (1 to 1000) to prevent potential integer overflow when calculating memory allocation sizes.
parsed.how_trigger_is_blocked: The trigger described in the finding no longer works because the program now checks if the value of N is within a reasonable range (1 to 1000) before proceeding with memory allocation. If N is outside this range, the program prints an error message and exits, preventing any overflow in the memory allocation calculations.
parsed.behavior_changes: The program now checks if the value of N is within a reasonable range (1 to 1000). If N is outside this range, the program will print an error message and exit instead of proceeding with memory allocation, which could lead to integer overflow.
